profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Enthusiastic and results-driven Software Engineer with a knack for turning complex ideas into elegant, user-friendly solutions. Adept at full-stack development, I thrive in fast-paced environments and bring a creative, can-do approach to problem-solving. With a commitment to continuous learning and a passion for clean, efficient code, I am eager to contribute my skills to innovative projects and collaborate with professionals that know when to be conservative and know when to push the envelope.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Full-Stack Application Modernization
Enhanced and maintained the SpliceCore application, a mission-critical platform featuring a Python/Flask backend and Vue.js frontend that provides seamless internal access to cloud services for biotechnology workflows.

DevOps & CI/CD Implementation
Architected and deployed comprehensive CI/CD pipelines that revolutionized our deployment process, achieving a 99% reduction in deployment time. Established automated workflows encompassing test execution, semantic versioning, package deployment, and Docker image building with intelligent tagging strategies.

Quality Engineering & Test-Driven Development
Spearheaded the implementation of robust testing frameworks and established organization-wide testing standards, resulting in a 50% increase in code coverage across all application components. Championed test-driven development practices to ensure code reliability and maintainability.

Containerization & Infrastructure
Endorsed the containerization initiative using Docker, transforming service deployment architecture to significantly enhance scalability, ensure deployment consistency, and improve development environment standardization across teams.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · GitHub · Python · Docker Products · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Neo4j · Kubernetes · Docker Products · Jira · Argo · Front-End Development · Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of the feature development team, I played a crucial role in driving the technological and cultural aspects within my organization.

API Development:
Collaborated with senior engineers to architect and implement a company search API, enhancing search capabilities and delivering a more efficient user experience.

Data Collection Enhancement:
Engaged proactively with the team to lead the overhaul of company data collection features on the platform, resulting in improved data accuracy, resiliency and streamlined processes.

Front-End Development:
Translated UI/UX team’s Figma designs into a user-centric front end, ensuring an intuitive and visually appealing user interface.

Database Expertise:
Developed and optimized SQL queries to support various data-driven features, contributing to a seamless, accurate and responsive data management system,

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Neo4j · Kubernetes · Docker Products · Jira · Argo · Front-End Development · Communication

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
As part of the in house development team, responsibilities were focused on end-to-end feature development.

Employee Onboarding System:
Engineered a comprehensive employee onboarding system, designed to streamline and centralize the management of employee records, signed agreements, and essential training materials. This initiative significantly reduced onboarding time and enhanced overall organizational efficiency.

Document Storage and Verification:
Spearheaded the digitization of documents and verification processes, providing the company with a robust and secure platform to better comply with audit standards. This initiative ensured regulatory compliance and quicker access to critical information.

Data-Driven Document Generator:
Developed a dynamic and data-driven document generator tailored for the customer service team. This tool enabled swift and accurate document creation, enhancing the team's ability to promptly respond to client needs. Resulted in a notable increase in client satisfaction and operational efficiency.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Website Performance Optimization:
Successfully enhanced the company website's user experience by optimizing site resources, resulting in over 50% improvement in load time. Employed various optimization techniques to ensure optimal website performance.

Content Management Expertise:
Diligently managed and updated the company's website content using WordPress, CSS, and JavaScript. Played a key role in ensuring the website's relevance and freshness.

SEO-Optimized Website Development:
Collaborated with the tech lead to develop client websites, implementing the best SEO practices to generate high-volume and relevant traffic.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
Password Management Enhancement:
Engineered and streamlined the 'reset password' functionality using PHP and MySQL, implementing a secure process to send and set temporary passwords to the appropriate email addresses. This initiative enhanced user experience and ensured a swift and secure password recovery process.

User Profile Management Tools:
Collaborated with the administrative team to create tools for user profile management. Resulted in a streamlined, efficient and organized user profile management.
